behavior: A key that the list of a child popup does not stop goes to the list of the parent popup one time, also when `Teleport` moved the child popup. A close key of the child list that is also a navigation key of the parent list then closes the child list and moves the highlight of the parent list. A filterable parent takes the next highlight from the registered child trigger, including when the submenu is in another document or the consumer sets `aria-controls`.
